data.gender_notes: Felty is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'peltes', meaning 'clad in leather' or 'sheathed'. In ancient Greece, a 'peltast' was a type of warrior who wore a leather shield and fought from a distance with a javelin. The name Felty can symbolize strength, courage, and protection. The name Felty carries the meaning “Firm, Strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Felty usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
